name: Immersion-freezing INP spectra of filter-collected aerosol in 96-well PCR plates in an ethanol bath (FrESH, 0 to -35 C at 1 C/min)
plain_name: Count ice-forming particles from air filters in plate wells
description: Aerosol filter extracts are pipetted as 50 uL droplets into two 96-well PCR plates floating in a Lauda-chilled ethanol bath, cooled from 0 to -35 C at 1 C/min while a USB camera records backlit images every 10 s to detect each well freezing, giving ice-nucleating particle concentration spectra N_INP(T).
keywords: Count ice-forming particles from air filters in plate wells

sources.citation: Perez Fogwill G, Welti A (2026). Temperature uncertainty characterisation of the FrESH droplet-freezing assay. EGUsphere preprint egusphere-2026-3971

requirements.rationale: Each run sweeps the sample from 0 C to -35 C (273.15-238.15 K).
The calibration and spectra apply to a 1 C/min ramp.
Freezing events are detected optically with a camera viewing the wells.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
